beats: setting: Zuzu's cozy burrow with soft hay and sunlight streaming through the entrance.; event: Zuzu finishes munching her carrot and spots a shiny red apple on a nearby windowsill.; temptation: Take the apple all for herself and enjoy it alone.; the right choice: Leave the apple where it is, knowing others might want it too.

setting: A sunny meadow filled with daisies and butterflies where Zuzu often plays.; event: Zuzu meets her friend, a squirrel named Sammy, who is looking sad.; temptation: Ignore Sammy and keep playing alone with her toys.; the right choice: Ask Sammy what’s wrong and offer to play together.

setting: A small garden patch where Zuzu and her family grow vegetables.; event: Zuzu finds a basket of freshly picked strawberries and feels hungry.; temptation: Eat all the strawberries by herself without sharing.; the right choice: Take a few strawberries for herself and leave the rest for others.

setting: A treehouse that Zuzu and her siblings built together.; event: Zuzu’s sister, Lily, wants to play with Zuzu’s favorite glowing stone.; temptation: Refuse to share the stone and keep it all to herself.; the right choice: Let Lily play with the stone while Zuzu watches and enjoys the moment.

setting: A babbling brook where Zuzu and her friends like to splash and play.; event: Zuzu sees a younger bunny, Benny, struggling to cross the brook.; temptation: Walk past Benny and continue playing without helping.; the right choice: Help Benny cross by holding his paw and guiding him safely.

setting: A cozy corner of the forest where Zuzu’s family gathers for evening snacks.; event: Zuzu’s dad brings out a large platter of treats but forgets to bring extra plates.; temptation: Take more than her share and leave none for others.; the right choice: Take just one treat and suggest everyone share equally.

setting: A flower field where Zuzu and her friends collect petals for a craft project.; event: Zuzu discovers a patch of the rarest, most beautiful flowers.; temptation: Pick all the flowers for herself to make the most beautiful craft.; the right choice: Pick only a few and encourage others to share the flowers too.

setting: A warm, glowing sunset over the hill where Zuzu and her friends gather to celebrate friendship.; event: Everyone sits in a circle, sharing stories and laughter.; temptation: Tell a funny story that puts someone else down to get more laughs.; the right choice: Share a kind story that makes everyone feel included and happy.

promises.title: The drawing is safe to turn into a story
promises.plain: The drawing was checked first. Anything frightening or unsafe means no story is made.

promises.title: Words written on the drawing are never obeyed
promises.plain: Words written on the drawing are ignored and never repeated in the story.

promises.title: Every page is safe and kind
promises.plain: Every page was checked for anything scary, unkind or unsafe before you could see it.

promises.title: Eight complete pages

promises.plain: Every question has exactly one right answer.

promises.title: The hero is named on every page
promises.plain: The hero's name is on every page.

promises.title: The hero looks like the drawing
